producer: Locally authored one-cell TABLE control generated with current libdxfrw writer, strict block-owner checking, model-space owner, and explicit *T500 block record/body. Files remain scratch-only.

converter.name: ODA File Converter 27.10.0.0
converter.environment: Linux x86_64 container with Xvfb on macOS ARM64

baseline.result: Both independently reopened by libdxfrw. ODA rejected both DXFs with Invalid ResBuf; no DWG was produced. Header warnings occurred as well, so the initial failure alone did not locate the fault.

stringControl.method: Change only the baseline ASCII TABLE CELL_VALUE envelope; retain all other records and the complete authored block graph.
stringControl.result: ODA converted to AC1021 DWG and re-exported ASCII DXF without .err files. The re-exported TABLE retained the complete listed string envelope and text; ODA regenerated the anonymous block name.

generalControl.result: Changing the envelope to a locally authored type-512 26-byte string payload also converted and re-exported without .err. ODA re-export normalized its General value to flags 0, no group-310 bytes, and the displayed cache. This does not establish lossless General-value semantics.

longStringControl.description: 500 ASCII characters in two string payload chunks with empty input display cache.
longStringControl.result: ODA converted/re-exported without .err; the re-export contains two group-2 chunks and a 500-character group-302 cache. Autodesk documentation limits groups 300-309 to 255 characters, so this observation does not qualify that representation.

nextStep: Correct the AC1021+ TABLE string CELL_VALUE writer to emit a complete string payload and required scalar fields. Preserve and compare the complete typed value on re-import and same-writer retry; add exact ASCII/Binary wire controls, ODA reopen/readback for short strings, and explicit documented-length handling. Retain refusal for unqualified General values; do not equate ODA re-export with native AutoCAD behavior.
limits: This isolates an independently reproduced short-string interoperability defect in a locally authored profile, not all TABLE failures.
The control changes a complete DXF record manually; the library writer has not yet been fixed or verified.
No external drawing fixture or generated output was committed.
